FN-GG51CC2-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 329
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Chad Robertson
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/08/2024
House Bill 329 as introduced would revise the membership of the Jacksonville State University
(JSU) Board of Trustees to include two additional at-large members, which could increase the
obligations of JSU by an estimated $360 per in-person meeting.
